description: Component for monitoring an S3 bucket prefix for new objects.

bucket_name.label: Bucket Name
bucket_name.description: Name of the S3 bucket to monitor

prefix.label: Prefix
prefix.description: S3 key prefix to scope monitoring (e.g., 'incoming/' or 'data/2024/')

key_pattern.label: Key Pattern
key_pattern.description: Regex pattern to match object keys (e.g., '.*\.parquet$' for Parquet files)

job_name.label: Job Name
job_name.description: Name of the job to trigger when objects are detected

minimum_interval_seconds.label: Minimum Interval Seconds
minimum_interval_seconds.description: Minimum time (in seconds) between sensor evaluations

region_name.label: Region Name
region_name.description: AWS region name (e.g., 'us-east-1'). Uses default boto3 region if not set.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Optional Dagster resource key providing an AWS client. When set,

default_status.label: Default Status
default_status.description: Default status of the sensor (running or stopped)

partition_mode.label: Partition Mode
partition_mode.description: How detected S3 objects are surfaced. 'run_config' (default): embed bucket/key/etag/etc in run_config (pair with file_ingestion.from_run_config). 'dynamic_partition': register each new key as a dynamic partition and yield RunRequest(partition_key=...). 'both': both.

dynamic_partitions_name.label: Dynamic Partitions Name
dynamic_partitions_name.description: Required when partition_mode is 'dynamic_partition' or 'both'. Must match the downstream asset's dynamic_partition_name.

partition_key_template.label: Partition Key Template
partition_key_template.description: Template for the partition key per detected object. Fields: {bucket}, {key}, {prefix}. Default {key} is the bare S3 key. Use s3://{bucket}/{key} for the full URI as the partition key (note: '://' breaks Dagster's filesystem IO manager — keep the bare key unless you're using a custom IO manager).

op_name.label: Op Name
op_name.description: Op name to key the run_config under. Emitted as `{'ops': {op_name: {'config': {...}}}}`. Defaults to 'config' for backward compat, but if the target job's op is not named 'config' (e.g. an @asset or @multi_asset with a custom name), set this to the actual op name — otherwise Dagster rejects the run config with 'Received unexpected config entry "config" at path root:ops'.

source_asset_key.label: Source Asset Key
source_asset_key.description: Optional asset key (e.g. 's3_landing_zone') to receive an AssetObservation on every tick that yields new objects. Metadata includes bucket, prefix, new_objects, last_key, last_modified — lets an observable-source asset in the graph show a live timeline of object arrivals in the Dagster UI.

emit_materialization.description: When True (default), the sensor emits AssetMaterialization. When False, emits AssetObservation instead. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.
emit_materialization.label: Emit Materialization

dynamic_partition_keep_days.label: Dynamic Partition Keep Days
dynamic_partition_keep_days.description: When set (partition_mode='dynamic_partition' or 'both'), partitions this sensor registered are deleted once older than this many days -- dynamic partitions otherwise accumulate forever. Tracked via a small local JSON state file (dynamic_partition_state_path), independent of the sensor's own cursor. Unset (default): no pruning.

dynamic_partition_state_path.label: Dynamic Partition State Path
dynamic_partition_state_path.description: Where dynamic_partition_keep_days persists its {partition_key: first_seen} state. Defaults to './{sensor_name}_dynamic_partition_state.json'. Ignored when dynamic_partition_keep_days is unset.

business_key_template.label: Business Key Template
business_key_template.description: Required when partition_mode='business_key_batch'. Template extracting a business-key value (e.g. a bank code) from each detected object's key -- same template fields as `partition_key_template` (`{bucket}`, `{key}`, `{prefix}`, `{file_stem}`, `{file_name}`, `{key_stem}`), plus `{key_parts[N]}` (0-indexed path components of the key relative to `prefix`, e.g. `{key_parts[0]}` is `bank_alpha` for key `incoming/bank_alpha/file.enc` with prefix `incoming/`). Default `{key_parts[0]}` covers the common `<prefix>/<business_key>/<file>` layout.

business_key_dimension_name.label: Business Key Dimension Name
business_key_dimension_name.description: Name of the business-key dimension in the downstream asset's `MultiPartitionsDefinition` (e.g. 'bank'). Only used when partition_mode='business_key_batch'.

batch_dimension_name.label: Batch Dimension Name
batch_dimension_name.description: Name of the time-window dimension in the downstream asset's `MultiPartitionsDefinition` (e.g. 'batch_day'). Only used when partition_mode='business_key_batch'.

batch_window.label: Batch Window
batch_window.description: Time-window granularity for the batch dimension when partition_mode='business_key_batch'. Only 'daily' is supported today (pair with a `DailyPartitionsDefinition(..., end_offset=1)` on the downstream asset). Hourly batching is possible via the same mechanism but isn't exposed yet -- at real multi-tenant scale (e.g. 100 keys) hourly batching reaches Dagster's partition-count guidance in months (100 x 24 x 365 = 876,000/year) where daily stays comfortably under it for years (100 x 365 = 36,500/year); daily is the recommended default, not just the only option today.

business_keys.label: Business Keys
business_keys.description: Required when partition_mode='business_key_batch'. The FIXED list of valid business-key values -- must match the downstream asset's `StaticPartitionsDefinition` values exactly. Unlike dynamic partitions, static partition values can't be registered at runtime, so this is declared, not discovered. An object whose extracted business key isn't in this list is SKIPPED (logged as a warning, not a sensor failure) rather than raising, so one unexpected object doesn't block every other key's batch this tick.
